facts.fact: MoFPED's monitoring covered IRAS in nine cities, the tenth city, Jinja, still using e-LogRev, in the first half of FY2024/25; the report also says IRAS is being rolled out in all LGs but gives no count.
LG own revenue reached 37 percent of the annual budget at half-year FY2024/25, up from 24.35 percent at half-year of the FY2019/20 baseline, which MoFPED attributes to the IRAS rollout across LGs.
